elements.label: Morland's Shop
elements.description: The dim premises of Miss Morland, who deals in rare and sometimes dangerous books.

elements.label: Morland's Shop [Closed]
elements.description: This used to be the address of Morland's, the book dealer, but I'll have to look elsewhere for knowledge, now.

elements.label: Oriflamme's Auction House
elements.description: Oriflamme's specialises in curios, perfumes, taxidermy specimens, and rare texts. It operates from cramped new premises, now, since the destruction of the old by an unexplained fire. [You can buy or sell items at Oriflamme's.]

slots.label: Sell
slots.description: Add an item here to auction it off.

elements.label: The Ecdysis Club [Closed]
elements.description: A cabaret with an occult reputation. It opens only certain nights of the week; it'll re-open soon.

elements.label: The Ecdysis Club
elements.description: A cabaret with an occult reputation.

elements.label: Abandoned Headquarters
elements.description: Forget it, J.N.

elements.label: Headquarters?
elements.description: [Headquarters mechanics have changed.]

elements.label: Temporary Headquarters
elements.description: Our business is private. We could use somewhere more secret.

elements.label: Opulent Townhouse
elements.description: We always close the curtains tight before we roll back the rugs and mark the floor with chalk.

elements.label: Heterodox Church
elements.description: Even on Sunday morning, there are quirks in the order of service, but most outsiders don't notice. Outsiders are not invited to the ceremonies we hold at chillier hours.

elements.label: Candle-lit Mithraeum
elements.description: Initiates have celebrated the Mysteries here for almost two thousand years. The words change, the gods change, but always, eventually, there is blood.

elements.label: House Violet
elements.description: We've painted the walls within the rich colour of the Violet Chamber. We've cleaned the cobwebs and placed unobtrusive shutters behind all the windows. And we've replaced all the locks.

elements.label: Rooms Behind a Bookshop
elements.description: The lesser elements of Miss Morland's stock yet remain. Over time, strangers drift in with books to sell, and sometimes we indulge them.

elements.label: A Darkened Warehouse
elements.description: The rafters are rank with rats. Their smell is almost lost beneath the reek of the river. It's a long way from anywhere anyone would want to go. All these things are, in their way, advantages.

elements.label: Unattended Church
elements.description: The minister disappeared, one night, quite abruptly, with his inner circle and the church's chiefest treasures. He is widely assumed to have gone to a better place: possibly a sunny place beside a shining sea. We could recruit his leaderless flock, and make this our base of operations.

elements.label: Empty Mithraeum
elements.description: This was a place of worship, once. We could make it so again.

elements.label: Empty Hospital
elements.description: Phantoms - the neighbours say - still walk the echoing halls here. If we take possession, of course, they will leave, or we'll turn them to our use.

elements.label: An Abandoned Warehouse
elements.description: A rotting shell beside a rotting river. Who would follow us here?

elements.label: Streets Strange by Moonlight
elements.description: Sometimes, the light of the moon is a key to other spaces. I've found a place where, for a night or two, the streets curve in unfamiliar ways. If I walk here, I might find insight, or I might be touched by madness.

elements.label: The Montmerenzi-McDonald Gallery
elements.description: Alistair Montmerenzi, third and last of the Montmerenzi cartographers, and his enigmatic benefactor Timothy McDonald, collected this small but striking miscellany. After their loss on their final polar expedition, the collection was made available to the public in a blank-faced grey building beside a quiet park... on condition that no piece of art therein was ever to be photographed, nor exposed to daylight.

elements.label: Cemetery
elements.description: In the waking world, as in dreams, the dead are most often found below.

elements.label: Closely Watched Cemetery
elements.description: The authorities have noticed peculiar activity in this place. They have set a watch upon it. Visits will take longer, and very soon they will no longer be possible at all.
